title: Add vuln-scan-fs and vuln-scan-image Trivy steps
description: Replace the single security-scan step with vuln-scan-fs (filesystem, runs on every push) and vuln-scan-image (image, runs on main only). Both write JSON artifacts for DefectDojo ingestion. Neither is a hard gate at v0.2.

tasks.title: Replace security-scan with vuln-scan-fs step in .woodpecker.yml
tasks.description: Remove the existing security-scan step. Add a new step named vuln-scan-fs using aquasec/trivy:latest with DORA structured JSON logging. Command: trivy fs --format json --output artifacts/security/trivy-repo.json --no-progress . (exit-code 0, no hard gate). No when: branch restriction. Include comment explaining the latest tag exception for scanner images.
acceptance: Step named 'vuln-scan-fs' exists in .woodpecker.yml steps list
Image is aquasec/trivy:latest
Commands include '--format json --output artifacts/security/trivy-repo.json --no-progress .'
Step has NO when: branch restriction
Commands do NOT include '--exit-code 1' (no hard gate)
Comment explains latest tag exception for scanner images
Old 'security-scan' step is removed from .woodpecker.yml
DORA structured JSON logging present in step commands

tasks.title: Add vuln-scan-image step to .woodpecker.yml
tasks.description: Add a new step named vuln-scan-image using aquasec/trivy:latest with DORA structured JSON logging. Command: trivy image --format json --output artifacts/security/trivy-image.json --no-progress ${REGISTRY_USERNAME}/${CI_REPO_NAME}:${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}. Has when: branch: main condition. Requires REGISTRY_USERNAME secret from_secret.
acceptance: Step named 'vuln-scan-image' exists in .woodpecker.yml steps list
Image is aquasec/trivy:latest
Commands include '--format json --output artifacts/security/trivy-image.json --no-progress'
Commands reference CI_REPO_NAME and CI_COMMIT_SHA for image reference
Step has when: condition with branch: main
Step has environment.REGISTRY_USERNAME.from_secret: registry_username
Comment explains latest tag exception for scanner images
DORA structured JSON logging present in step commands

tasks.title: Add TestVulnScanFsStep and TestVulnScanImageStep test classes
tasks.description: Add two new test classes to tests/unit/test_woodpecker_yml.py. TestVulnScanFsStep: validates step existence, image, JSON format output, output path, --no-progress flag, scans current dir, no branch restriction, no hard gate exit code, DORA logging. TestVulnScanImageStep: validates step existence, image, JSON format output, output path, --no-progress flag, branch main only, registry username secret, CI variable usage, DORA logging.
